purpose: Exploratory baseline for natural, previously unmodeled user utterances. Freeze before observing results; do not tune production code against this file before the first run.

scoring_policy.manual_review: Cases with manual_review=true require response-level review for unsupported inference, fabricated facts, guarantees, or UX quality.
scoring_policy.baseline_rule: First execution must use the frozen main SHA above with no production behavior changes made from these cases.
scoring_policy.post_baseline_rule: Cluster failures by risk/category before changing code. Keep a holdout subset when converting failures into regression tests.
